decisions.question: What moves a project adapter scope?
decisions.choice: Configuration and branch move scope; source content changes drift inside the same scope
decisions.changeMechanism: bump the adapter/schema contract and its fixtures; no fallback branch

decisions.question: When can missing/deleted be concluded?
decisions.choice: All evidence is mandatory; otherwise status is unknown/blocking
decisions.changeMechanism: change the comparator decision table and schemas together

decisions.question: Can API/semantic and visual results upgrade one another?
decisions.choice: No; semantic status and six-state visual status remain independent
tests: visual evidence drift stays on the visual axis

decisions.question: Where is retry authority stored and how is it retained?
evidence: mapping mutation must survive process restart and crash between commit/response
an evicted request retains an older expected mapping revision and therefore loses CAS
decisions.choice: Commit receipts atomically in registry bytes and retain the newest 1000; evict oldest by count only, never by age
tests: exact replay returns same receipt even when current generation is unavailable
decisions.changeMechanism: owner-reviewed mapping schema revision; never process-memory or age-based fallback

decisions.question: May an external component mapping invent platform or scope?
decisions.choice: No; use an exact published adapter identity or explicit owner-supplied platform and sha256 scope
tests: external mappings cannot invent a zero scope
